subtitles.en: with world-class infrastructure, manufacturing capacity, and talent.

subtitles.zh: 但中国的崛起并非孤立发生。
subtitles.en: But China's rise didn't happen in a vacuum.

subtitles.zh: 上世纪70年代末，邓小平着手推动中国现代化时，曾向海外寻找思路。有一个地方格外突出：新加坡。
subtitles.en: In the late 1970s, as Deng Xiaoping set out to modernize China, he looked abroad for ideas. One place stood out Singapore.

subtitles.zh: 而中国并非唯一取经者。几十年来，从印度到巴西，多国政府都曾向新加坡学习
subtitles.en: And China wasn't the only country taking notes. Over the decades, governments from India to Brazil have looked to Singapore for lessons on

subtitles.zh: 增长与治理之道，成效各有不同。
subtitles.en: growth and governance with varying degrees of success.

subtitles.zh: 但当初催生新加坡模式的世界，正在改变。
subtitles.en: But the world that helped create the Singapore model is changing.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，如果新加坡今天才起步，我不确定新加坡模式还能奏效。
subtitles.en: Indeed, if Singapore were to start today, I am not sure the Singapore model will work.

subtitles.zh: 因为世界正变得更加保护主义，全球化已不复当年。
subtitles.en: Because the world is getting more protectionist, globalization is not there anymore.

subtitles.zh: 陈庆珠大使是新加坡最受尊敬的战略思想家之一。
subtitles.en: Ambassador Chan-Hing Chi is one of Singapore's most respected strategic minds.

subtitles.zh: 她与经济学和政治学教授普什和多特一同做客本期节目。地点在西雅图。
